notes: All PAM LLM routes (OpenAI, same-server vLLM) use these values. Addresses, model names and provider fields are chosen by INFERENCE_MODE in src/infer/endpoints.ts.
The 120-second timeout and the 2048/16384 output-token caps are caller safeguards, not paper settings. The timeout covers the whole call including the body read.
Reasoning tokens can consume the output cap. A result whose finish_reason is neither stop nor null is rejected, not accepted as a valid result.
No response repair, automatic retry, or alternative model is enabled.
Temperature 0.3 and role-specific reasoning come from config/paper.json, not this file.
